render.style: cut on beat boundaries; word-level burned captions; GEM logo bug top-right; 2s end card
render.landscapeClips: none: all clips are vertical 9:16 sources; feed and 16:9 variants are reframed from the vertical master
render.shortClips: Some clips run 4-8s. When a clip is shorter than its beat, the renderer adds a second Pexels clip from the same beat theme; it never loops or slows footage.

contentRules: All clips are Pexels License: free commercial and social use, modification allowed, no attribution required (credit appreciated). Mixkit excluded because part of its catalogue is personal-use only.
People shown are not GEM clients, staff or endorsers. Never caption them as such (Pexels prohibits implied endorsement).
No identifiable person may be shown in a negative light; threat beats use masked or faceless footage only.
No SLAs, certifications, response times or guarantees in voiceover or captions (public-claims control).
Each video stays DRAFT until approved in Approvals; exact-version approval required before publishing.
